findings.observation: Sheet 5 Block 11 has FIRE DEPARTMENT section with 7 notes. Vision tool transcribed verbatim. Compared to reference: Notes 1,2,3,6,7 match. Note 4 states within 150 feet (ref: 100 feet). Note 5 states combustible waste material and trash bins (ref: commercial dumpsters and containers).
findings.reasoning: Checklist requires ~90% semantic matching, flexible location. All 7 topics covered but two substantive alterations: 150ft vs 100ft changes approval trigger distance; combustible waste limitation narrows scope from all commercial dumpsters. These are technical specification changes, not acceptable variations.
findings.explanation: Fire Department notes contain substantive alterations: Note 4 specifies 150 feet instead of 100, Note 5 limited to combustible waste instead of all commercial dumpsters/containers
findings.resolution: Revise Fire Department notes on Sheet 5 to match standard text: Note 4 change '150 feet' to '100 feet', Note 5 change 'combustible waste material and trash bins' to 'commercial dumpsters and containers'. See the CoA standard notes template (https://austin.widen.net/s/vxznrtmfwf/sp_consolidatedsiteplanapplication_notestemplates) for expected notes.

resolutionDetails.expected:
All pervious/decorative paving shall be engineered and installed for 80,000 lb. live-vehicle loads. Any pervious/decorative paving within 100 feet of any building must be approved by the Fire Department.

Commercial dumpsters and containers with an individual capacity of 1.5 cubic yards or greater shall not be stored or placed within ten feet of openings, combustible walls, or combustible eave lines.
resolutionDetails.actual:
ALL PERVIOUS/DECORATIVE PAVING SHALL BE ENGINEERED AND INSTALLED FOR 80,000 LB. LIVE-VEHICLE LOADS. ANY PERVIOUS/DECORATIVE PAVING WITHIN 150 FEET OF ANY BUILDING MUST BE APPROVED BY THE FIRE DEPARTMENT.

COMBUSTIBLE WASTE MATERIAL AND TRASH BINS WITH AN INDIVIDUAL CAPACITY OF 1.5 CUBIC YARDS OR GREATER SHALL NOT BE STORED OR PLACED WITHIN TEN FEET OF OPENINGS, COMBUSTIBLE WALLS, OR COMBUSTIBLE ROOF EAVES.

findings.summary: 8 of 11 items pass, 2 items fail (CC-3-17: incomplete sheet index; AF-01: Fire Department notes substantively altered), 2 not-applicable (BSZ and Great Streets/UNO)
